title: Claims Deduction from a Northgate Protect Standard Plan Cancellation Refund
content:
A claims deduction comes off the Northgate Protect Standard plan cancellation refund for settlements booked on the plan:

- **Any repair, replacement or reimbursement settlement booked:** the other-settlement share, the whole of it (a share of 1), of all the plan's settlements, food-loss payments included;
- **Only food-loss payments booked:** the food-only share, one half (0.5), of those payments;
- **None booked:** nothing.

| Settlements on the plan's ledger | Deduction |
|---|---|
| At least one repair, replacement or reimbursement | All settlements in full |
| Food-loss payments only | One half of the food-loss payments |
| None | Nothing |

## Cases on hypothetical figures

- A plan carries one $90.00 food-loss payment and nothing else: $45.00 comes off.
- A plan carries a $60.00 repair and a $40.00 food-loss payment: $100.00 comes off.
- A plan with no settlement: nothing comes off.
